name: Sinoatrial Node Dysfunction and Deafness
aliases: Sinoatrial Node Dysfunction Associated with Deafness

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Sinoatrial Node Dysfunction and Deafness

criteria.description: Documented sinoatrial node dysfunction evidenced by sinus bradycardia, sinus arrest, or chronotropic incompetence on ECG or Holter monitoring
Bilateral sensorineural hearing loss confirmed by audiometry, typically congenital or early onset
Positive family history of sinoatrial node dysfunction and/or sensorineural deafness consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with sinoatrial node dysfunction and deafness (e.g., HCN4, SCN5A)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of documented sinoatrial node dysfunction and bilateral sensorineural hearing loss
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory; exclusion of other causes of bradyarrhythmia and deafness is essential.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Sinus bradycardia with sinus arrest episodes

searchTerms: heart rate doesn't increase with exercise
inability to raise heart rate during activity

occasional.symptomName: Syncope due to sinus node pauses
searchTerms: passing out caused by heart rhythm pauses

occasional.symptomName: Mild developmental delay secondary to hearing impairment
searchTerms: mild learning delay from hearing loss
slow development related to hearing impairment

rare.symptomName: Atrial fibrillation or other supraventricular arrhythmias
Congestive heart failure symptoms secondary to bradycardia
searchTerms: heart failure symptoms from slow heart rate
congestive heart failure due to bradycardia
fluid buildup related to slow heartbeat

rare.symptomName: Severe speech delay due to profound deafness
searchTerms: profound hearing loss causing speech problems
delayed talking due to hearing impairment

laboratory: Normal routine blood tests; no specific biomarkers identified
imaging: ECG showing sinus bradycardia, sinus pauses, or arrest
Holter monitoring demonstrating sinoatrial node dysfunction
other: Audiometry confirming bilateral sensorineural hearing loss

distinguishingFeatures: Sinoatrial node dysfunction without associated deafness

redFlags: Signs of heart failure or severe bradycardia
